system: San Lorenzo Ruiz Parish Management System (TUGON)

statuses.meaning_en: Your request has been received by the system and is currently queued for review by the parish staff.
statuses.meaning_fil: Natanggap na ang inyong kahilingan sa sistema at kasalukuyang nakapila para suriin ng parish staff.
statuses.parishioner_action_en: Wait for staff verification. You can check your request status anytime under 'My Requests' using your Reference Number.
statuses.parishioner_action_fil: Hintayin ang pagsusuri ng staff. Maaari ninyong tingnan ang status anumang oras sa 'My Requests' gamit ang inyong Reference Number.
statuses.staff_action_en: Verify submitted requirements (PSA, IDs, payment slip). In 'Requests' -> 'Review Status & Updates', update status to 'Processing' or 'Rejected' if documents are incomplete.
statuses.staff_action_fil: Suriin ang mga isinumiteng dokumento (PSA, valid ID, resibo). Sa 'Requests' -> 'REVIEW STATUS & UPDATES', palitan ang status sa 'Processing' o 'Rejected' kung kulang ang dokumento.

statuses.meaning_en: Your documents and payment have been verified. The parish office is searching church registry books, preparing your certificate, or confirming the priest's schedule for your blessing or service.
statuses.meaning_fil: Na-verify na ang inyong mga dokumento at bayad. Hinahanap na ng parish office ang talaan sa libro ng parokya, inihahanda ang sertipiko, o kinukumpirma ang iskedyul ng pari para sa basbas o serbisyo.
statuses.parishioner_action_en: Preparation typically takes 1 to 3 working days. No action needed unless contacted by staff.
statuses.parishioner_action_fil: Karaniwang tumatagal ng 1 hanggang 3 araw ng trabaho ang paghahanda. Walang kailangang gawin maliban kung kontakin ng kawani.
statuses.staff_action_en: Match sacramental registry record, generate digital certificate via 'Generate Certificate' or assign minister/date in 'REVIEW STATUS & UPDATES'.
statuses.staff_action_fil: Itugma sa rekord ng parokya, gumawa ng sertipiko sa 'Generate Certificate' o magtalaga ng pari at petsa sa 'REVIEW STATUS & UPDATES'.

statuses.meaning_en: Your certificate has been prepared and signed, and is now ready for in-person collection at the parish office, or your event schedule is locked in.
statuses.meaning_fil: Naihanda at nalagdaan na ang inyong sertipiko at handa nang kunin sa tanggapan ng parokya, o kumpirmado na ang iskedyul ng inyong aktibidad.
statuses.parishioner_action_en: Visit the parish office during office hours with your Reference Number and 1 Valid ID.
statuses.parishioner_action_fil: Pumunta sa tanggapan ng parokya sa oras ng opisina dala ang inyong Reference Number at 1 Valid ID.
statuses.staff_action_en: Store signed and sealed certificate in the pickup tray; hand over upon presenting valid ID.
statuses.staff_action_fil: Ihanda ang napirmahan at naselyuhang sertipiko sa pickup tray; ibigay kapag nagpakita ng valid ID.

statuses.meaning_en: The request has been fully fulfilled. For online certificate requests, the official PDF is available for download. For blessings or sacramental services, the ceremony has been concluded.
statuses.meaning_fil: Ganap nang natapos ang kahilingan. Para sa online na sertipiko, maaari nang i-download ang opisyal na PDF. Para sa basbas o sakramento, natapos na ang seremonya.
statuses.parishioner_action_en: Go to 'My Requests' and click the green 'Download Certificate' button to get your verified PDF copy, or check completed ceremony records.
statuses.parishioner_action_fil: Pumunta sa 'My Requests' at i-click ang berdeng 'Download Certificate' button upang makuha ang inyong opisyal na PDF, o tingnan ang tala ng natapos na seremonya.
statuses.staff_action_en: Certificate marked released or ceremony recorded in church books. Record is archived.
statuses.staff_action_fil: Nai-release na ang sertipiko o naitala na sa aklat ng parokya ang seremonya.

statuses.meaning_en: The request could not be processed due to incomplete/blurry documents, an unavailable date/time slot, or no matching church registry record.
statuses.meaning_fil: Hindi maiproseso ang kahilingan dahil sa kulang o malabong dokumento, may conflict sa iskedyul, o walang nahanap na tala sa aklat ng simbahan.
statuses.parishioner_action_en: Open your request in 'My Requests' to read the 'Admin Remarks'. Correct the indicated issue (upload clearer photo or pick a new available slot) and submit a new request.
statuses.parishioner_action_fil: Buksan ang inyong request sa 'My Requests' upang basahin ang 'Admin Remarks'. Itama ang tinukoy na dahilan (mag-upload ng mas malinaw na ID o pumili ng bakanteng oras) at magsumite muli.
statuses.staff_action_en: Always provide clear, specific admin remarks explaining why the request was rejected so the parishioner knows what to fix.
statuses.staff_action_fil: Palaging maglagay ng malinaw na paliwanag sa Admin Remarks upang malaman ng deboto ang dapat itama.

statuses.meaning_en: The request was cancelled by the requesting parishioner before staff processing, or voided by administration.
statuses.meaning_fil: Ang kahilingan ay kinansela ng humiling bago iproseso ng kawani, o pinawalang-bisa ng pamunuan.
statuses.parishioner_action_en: If you still need the service, please submit a new request.
statuses.parishioner_action_fil: Kung kailangan pa rin ang serbisyo, mangyaring magsumite ng bagong request.
statuses.staff_action_en: No further action needed. Associated schedule slots are released.
statuses.staff_action_fil: Wala nang aksyon. Ang kaugnay na slot sa iskedyul ay magiging available muli.
